scope: Read-only source review of the active qualifier, its exact retained patch, producer paths and 24 prepared tests. This JSON is the only file written by the review.

sourceEvidence.finding: Default clock is Date.now()/1000; trace allocates a positive sequential id and retains id/episode/kind/body/created. Checkpoint and restoration use ids and versions, not created ordering.
The authority constructs NativeReasoningMemory without a substituted clock and persists these records as native_reasoning_trace component_state nodes.
Both producer files become common provenance inputs and must fingerprint-identically to both captured native inventories. Receipt windows are taken only after existing capture provenance checks.

staticChecks.method: Python textual unified diff comparison; no imports or execution of the qualifier

staticChecks.name: exception_has_exact_trace_identity_and_envelope
staticChecks.details: Requires canonical positive safe trace id, component_state/native_reasoning_trace, real session scope, exact value/root/member/float64 keys, matching component/id, and common-observation-frontier episode.

staticChecks.name: clock_value_bound_to_own_role_receipt_and_stable_identity
staticChecks.details: Canonical role-specific closed receipt interval; finite float64 equal to an integer millisecond divided by1000; stability keyed by role/sessionId/nodeId.

staticChecks.name: body_nested_created_and_other_metadata_remain_exact
staticChecks.details: Only a shallow comparison copy of /value/root/members/created/bits is replaced. Entire body and every other node value/field remain in deep equality. origin.source_digest remains separately bound to the exact role runtime digest.

staticChecks.name: inputs_and_hash_inputs_not_normalized
staticChecks.details: Original nodes/deltas remain unchanged; temporary values are used only by commonNode after graph validation. No substitution in chains, fragments, tickets, executable digests or cause/order comparison.

staticChecks.name: attribution_commit_follows_success_of_all_common_node_fields
staticChecks.details: prepare validates both roles, then commonNode compares every other field; commit occurs only after those comparisons succeed.

staticChecks.name: new_policy_is_explicit_not_mislabelled_exact
staticChecks.details: commonValuePolicy and point coverage now state exact_except_attributed_trace_envelope_created and retain role/session/node timestamp records.

preparedTests.coverage: Positive comparison, immutable inputs, deduplicated per-role records, role-specific windows, finite and millisecond constraints, malformed encoding, stability in both roles, strict body/nested-created equality, metadata/origin rejection and absence of partial attribution.
notCoveredByTheseUnitTests: Complete capture provenance and producer-fingerprint rejection through Qualification.provenance
Execution of retained full graph/ticket/hash-chain validators

findings.description: The qualifier emits a new comparison name plus traceCreatedAttribution. Four active downstream readers still require the old exact policy object and exact point-coverage label. They will reject the new attribution even if its functional qualification succeeds.
findings.requiredResolution: Before a final cost contract or window, make a separately reviewed, prospective downstream adaptation that validates the precise temporal attribution and all its role/session/source/coverage bindings. Do not weaken these readers to accept arbitrary policy names or arbitrary value exceptions.

limits: No local comparison bypass or body-normalization defect was found in this source review; this is not a test-pass claim.
The timestamp is bounded by its whole role capture receipt, not reconstructed as the exact instant of each trace operation. Session identity and per-trace stability are checked separately.
The new unit tests are not proof that the complete qualifier or downstream cost pipeline passes.
Actual publication0.63, final source reconciliation and official cost acceptance remain outside this review.

recommendation.boundedUnitExecution: Source review supports root proceeding to the24 prepared tests under a new declared execution; none executed here.
recommendation.functionalQualification: After test success and root release, use fresh attribution/fixture output paths and retain the original refusal unchanged. All existing graph/hash/ticket validation must remain active.
recommendation.finalCostReadiness: Not ready: the four downstream exact-policy checks require the explicit reviewed adaptation above, followed by actual0.63 reconciliation and normal final evidence.
